questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers and riders can use hand signals instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out, it means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must give the right-of-way to other traffic. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if you need to before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must steer either to the right or to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign marks a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted several hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon join into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of the overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black lettering or symbols. This sign warns you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas ahead. Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that these parking spaces are reserved only for people who have valid disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead and a road is joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign means you must obey it. Do not pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a fork in the road ahead. You must choose to bear either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped yellow sign indicates a no passing zone.
